assigned_to: user (H2 gate g4); environment-concept if a re-draw is authorised
domain: scene whitebox vs layout_top.png vs Bible dimensions
summary: The walls in the whitebox follow the drawn walls (hard rule: walls are measured from the image, and X:Z is locked to the image aspect). Where the drawn plan and the Bible disagree, the whitebox follows the image/layout.json and marks the item inferred:true. The resulting metric sizes differ from the Bible as listed below. No image or layout.json was edited.

findings.issue: At the layout.json scale (30 m image width), the passage is 2.7-3.1 m wide (Bible 1.4 m), the straight run is about 11.6 m (Bible 25 m), and the landing chamber is 6.75 m across (Bible 3 m; the shaft above it is 2.4 m in SCN-falling-dream). No single scale matches both width and length.

The clear hall width is 6.8 m (Bible 5.5 m). The entrance passage is 2.8 m wide (Bible 1.4 m). The entrance is a side gap (Bible: NE corner). There are 10 + 9 doors (Bible 12 + 12). The table is drawn 2.5 m across (Bible 0.5 m).
findings.whitebox: Walls and gap as drawn; door leaves and the table at Bible size, placed at the drawn positions.

findings.issue: The clear width is 7.2 m (Bible 5.5 m) and the entrance passage 4 m wide. This frame is separate from SCN-long-hall and has a different scale, so the same hall measures differently in the two assets.
The passage is drawn 0.39 m wide (Bible 0.28 m). The hall doors 9/10 are not drawn on the hall wall, and the curtain is drawn inside the passage.
findings.whitebox: Stone faces as drawn. Jambs keep the 0.26 m door width. The doors and curtain are placed per architecture/layout.json.

findings.issue: The shaft is drawn elliptical (about 2.43 x 2.15 m) because the depth is squashed. A true 2.4 m circle only just fits the 2.81 m frame depth, so the rim was thinned to 0.18 m and the tunnel stub is about 0.2 m long.
The burrow is drawn about 2.8 m out in the field, not at the hedge foot (603-a). The hedge is drawn about 4.4 m deep. The gate is 8 m from the burrow (Bible 12 m) and the gate gap is 5.3 m.
The race circle is about 8 m across (Bible 10 m).

decision_needed: At H2, either accept the drawn proportions (the whitebox stands as delivered), or authorise environment-concept to re-draw the layout images. After a re-draw, scene-modeling re-measures the walls and reruns the check. The whitebox must not be forced to Bible sizes while the image differs, because the image is laid over the ground plane.
